strings.zh: 迷思 1：蕁麻疹一定是吃到過敏的東西
strings.en: Myth 1: Urticaria must be from a food allergy

strings.zh: 迷思 2：蕁麻疹反覆發作 = 免疫力差
strings.en: Myth 2: Recurrent urticaria means a weak immune system

strings.zh: 迷思 3：抗組織胺會嗜睡、傷腦、會吃上癮
strings.en: Myth 3: Antihistamines cause drowsiness, harm the brain, and are addictive

strings.zh: 迷思 4：蕁麻疹會傳染家人
strings.en: Myth 4: Urticaria spreads to family members

strings.zh: 迷思 5：慢性蕁麻疹治不好，只能一輩子吃藥
strings.en: Myth 5: Chronic urticaria is incurable; you must take pills lifelong

strings.zh: 迷思 6：做過敏原檢測就能找出蕁麻疹病因
strings.en: Myth 6: Allergy testing identifies the cause of urticaria

strings.en: A 2024 JAMA review notes that > 50% of CSU is autoimmune-mediated (IgE or IgG autoantibodies). The following raise strong suspicion for autoimmune-type CSU:

strings.en: JAMA 2024 lists several novel agents in Phase 3 trials:

strings.zh: 這些新藥不久將提供「無類固醇、無免疫抑制劑」的選項。
strings.en: These newer drugs will soon provide steroid-free, immunosuppressant-free options.

strings.zh: 抓破皮也不會把「東西」傳給別人
strings.en: Even if you scratch open the skin, nothing transmissible spreads to others

strings.zh: 跟「過敏體質」可能有家族傾向（基因）但不會「人傳人」
strings.en: An atopic predisposition can run in families (genetic), but it doesn't spread person-to-person

strings.zh: 少數頑固型可能持續 10 年以上
strings.en: A small refractory subset can persist beyond 10 years

strings.zh: 盲目避開「測到陽性」的食物會造成營養不均、社交困擾
strings.en: Blindly avoiding all foods that test positive causes nutritional imbalance and social difficulties

strings.zh: 明確時間相關 — 每次吃同一食物後 30 分鐘到 2 小時內發作
strings.en: Clear temporal relationship — symptoms appear within 30 minutes to 2 hours of eating the same food

strings.zh: 女性、症狀每週 > 5 天、合併血管性水腫、夜間癢醒
strings.en: Female sex, symptoms > 5 days/week, concurrent angioedema, nocturnal awakening from itch

strings.zh: 抗組織胺與 Omalizumab 反應差(總 IgE 太低時 Omalizumab 效果有限)
strings.en: Poor response to antihistamines and omalizumab (low total IgE limits omalizumab efficacy)

strings.zh: 正子 / 嗜鹼性球活化試驗(BAT、BHRA)陽性
strings.en: Positive basophil activation test (BAT) / basophil histamine-release assay (BHRA)

strings.zh: 建議基本檢驗:CBC、ESR / CRP、TSH、抗 TPO 抗體;其他依病史決定(如寄生蟲、肝炎篩檢)
strings.en: Recommended baseline workup: CBC, ESR/CRP, TSH, anti-TPO antibodies; further tests guided by history (e.g., parasites, hepatitis screening)

strings.zh: 嘴唇腫、眼皮腫、呼吸困難、頭暈喘不過氣
strings.en: lip swelling, eyelid swelling, dyspnea, dizziness, breathlessness

strings.zh: 找不到明確原因（自發性）

strings.en: So don't rush to identify a culprit

strings.zh: 規律抗組織胺 + 必要時生物製劑（Omalizumab）
新一代抗組織胺很安全
第二代抗組織胺每天規律使用
自身肥大細胞釋放組織胺
strings.en: release of histamine from one's own mast cells

strings.zh: 300 mg 月劑量可使絕大多數對抗組織胺無效的 CSU 病人顯著改善
strings.en: 300 mg monthly produces marked improvement in the majority of antihistamine-refractory CSU patients

strings.zh: Barzolvolimab、Briquilimab（抗 KIT，直接耗竭肥大細胞）
strings.en: Barzolvolimab, briquilimab (anti-KIT, directly deplete mast cells)

strings.zh: 慢性蕁麻疹根本不是 IgE-mediated 食物過敏
strings.en: Chronic urticaria is fundamentally not IgE-mediated food allergy

strings.zh: 第二代抗組織胺標準劑量
應轉介專科或考慮升階治療
strings.en: Refer to specialist or consider treatment escalation

strings.zh: 誘發性蕁麻疹合併比例
30% CSU 病人對 300 mg/月 omalizumab 反應不足
strings.en: 30% of CSU patients have inadequate response to 300 mg/month omalizumab

strings.zh: 50% 在 1 年內、80% 在 5 年內自然緩解
除非每次發作前都吃同一食物 30 分-2 小時內（明確時間相關）
strings.en: Unless every flare follows the same food within 30 minutes to 2 hours (clear temporal link)

strings.zh: 慢性自發性蕁麻疹有條件給付
strings.en: Chronic spontaneous urticaria has conditional NHI coverage

strings.zh: 常見、可治、會自己好的疾病
規律抗組織胺 + 找出可能誘發物 + 必要時生物製劑
strings.en: Scheduled antihistamines + identifying possible triggers + biologics when needed

strings.en: Is it always allergy? Do antihistamines cause drowsiness? Can chronic urticaria be cured?

strings.zh: 持續 2-4 週評估；規律每日使用，不要「等發作才吃」
strings.en: Assess after 2–4 weeks; use daily on schedule rather than only when flaring

strings.zh: 4 週反應率 42%、8 週反應率 62.5%(vs 安慰劑 0%、23.3%);需密切監測血壓、肌酸酐
strings.en: 4-week response rate 42%, 8-week 62.5% (vs placebo 0%, 23.3%); requires close monitoring of blood pressure and creatinine

strings.en: Patients with prior anaphylaxis should carry an epinephrine auto-injector
